title: sphaeralcea ambigua var. rugosa
intro: Sphaeralcea ambigua var. rugosa, commonly known as the Orange Globe Mallow, is a perennial plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is a member of the mallow family (Malvaceae) and is valued for its vibrant orange flowers and potential medicinal properties. The health benefits of Sphaeralcea ambigua var. rugosa include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
